what: Letters of the large English heading (or letter-image pieces) sit 25.6px to the right and transparent, then when visible slide in from the first letter on a .1s stagger, with opacity over .5s linear and position over a long 1.4s cubic-bezier(.11,.51,.13,1) deceleration — the vertical outer English text (ABOUT·NEWS) settles as if carried by the wind

options.x: Initial sideways offset (px), default 25.6 — for a title rotated vertically it appears downward on screen
options.fade: Opacity duration (sec), default .5 · move slot duration, default 1.4
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default top 85% (original IntersectionObserver, −15% from the bottom)
options.on: if load, right as it attaches
options.[data-fx-part=char]: Pre-split text pieces (letter images img also work) — if none, the text is split into characters
options.blur: Initial blur (px), default 0 — clears with the same length and curve as the position (see About text 3 of a site)
options.fade-ease: Opacity curve, default none (linear) — to make it settle together with position, use the same value as ease (Brand expo.out)

from.where: index.html .tn-ttl-en (original .top__ttl-en .text-wrap — each glyph image: opacity .5s linear · translateX(min(2.04vw,25.6px)) → 0 over 1.4s cubic-bezier(.11,.51,.13,1), transition-delay .1s apart each, IntersectionObserver rootMargin 0 0 −15% 0 + data-delay .2 then .active)
